migrationNotes: Original source GUIDs and import settings are preserved for images, fonts, audio, materials and prefabs.
F2Runtime keeps countryFonts/introductionFonts/payChannels. Only the original Mahjong legacy configuration, source table and Mahjong tile bindings were removed from its host resource component.
Four original script references are rebound by Framework2ReplicaAssetPreparation to the existing Spine and DOTween DLL components, using Unity-reported GUID and fileID.
All 340 sprite aliases preserve exact source subasset names; aliases and explicit selectors are included in AddressMap.

Unity Single-mode Sprite imports expose the exact PNG basename rather than the legacy atlas label. 18 selectors across 9 original textures are normalized to that actual name. Logical addresses, resource paths and texture bytes remain unchanged; Multi-mode selectors remain exact.
